This conditional only modifies array values and does not invoke any command substitutions, downloads, or data exfiltration when sourced. There are no top-level command substitutions (e.g., `$(curl ...)`, `$(wget ...)`) or uses of `eval` or similar shell features that could execute arbitrary code during sourcing.

All potentially dynamic behavior (such as Git operations or copying files) is contained within functions (`_local_fixes`, `pkgver`, `prepare`, etc.), which are not executed during `--printsrcinfo`. The use of `SKIP` for checksums is standard for VCS packages and irrelevant at this stage since no sources are downloaded. Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD poses no risk of malicious execution.
</details>
